title: Revolt of 'Oman after the death of Mohammad
description: The Prince of 'Oman had recently tendered allegiance to Mohammad, with 'Amr deputed as Resident. As soon as Mohammad was dead, the people rebelled under a rebel who claimed to be a prophet; the Prince fled to the mountains and 'Amr to Medina. Dated to the year 0632 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "II A.H. 632-633 A.D."
